title: Build and deploy pipeline pushing container images to a 1,200-store estate
provenance: Synthetic system authored for this corpus (wayfinder ticket 029). Not derived from, or sanitized from, any real system: there is nothing to leak by omission.
notes: Internal-systems case 1 of 2 (ticket 029). The trust shape no other case carries is authority flowing upward through a build: a developer's input becomes the artifact that runs in 1,200 stores, so the weakest gate on the input side — an unreviewed manual rebuild and an unverified dependency download — is the real authority over the estate, and the elevation lane is where the case's must-finds concentrate rather than the usual spoofing lane. Far from the payments exemplar in mechanism as well as domain: nothing is pushed anywhere, both the build and the deploy are pulls initiated by the lower-trust side, which puts every flow direction against the intuition that data flow and initiation agree. It also carries the corpus's only fully described credential — a shared build token, stated as identical across pipelines and never rotated — which is what lets the repudiation lane be graded on a stated fact rather than on an unknown.
